mapper.sql: select id, parent_id, project_id, scheme_id, notice_id, tax_price, not_tax_price, contact, phone, submit_status, bidding_status, ip_address, vendor_id, vendor_name, collect_deposit, twice_quot, twice_time, create_by, create_id, create_time, update_by, update_id, update_time, del_flag, twice_quot_version, price_change_state from tb_bidding_info
mapper.select: SELECT t1.expert_id ,t1.expert_name, t2.bus_score,t2.tech_score,t2.vendor_id,t2.bidding_info_id FROM tb_bidding_evaluat_expert t1 LEFT JOIN tb_expert_score t2 on t1.expert_id = t2.expert_id and t1.scheme_id = t2.scheme_id WHERE t1.notice_id = #{noticeId} and t1.del_flag = 0 and t2.del_flag = 0
